dogecoin.text: I found .11 BTC in an old exchange that I got from mining Dogecoin back in 2013.   Guess that worked out well enough.

I found my old dogecoin wallet and for several hours yesterday while it was updating it was telling me I had ~85,000 dogecoin I had collected in 2014.  Turns out in Dec of 2017 I sent them all off to an exchange where I either sold them or they sat until the exchange went under.
